settings.title: Support settings
settings.intro: Automatic replies answer while no agent has yet: an acknowledgement when a ticket opens, an away note outside working hours, and an answer the AI takes from your FAQs. They are always labelled "Automatic reply", never sent in an agent's name, and stop as soon as an agent answers or the customer asks for a person.
settings.enabled_hint: Turn this off to stop all of them at once.
settings.away_enabled: Reply outside working hours (instead of the acknowledgement)
settings.vars_ack: Leave a text empty to use the default shown inside it. :id is the ticket number.
settings.vars_away: Leave a text empty to use the default shown inside it. :id is the ticket number, :hours the working hours.
settings.away_every: Repeat the note at most every
settings.hours_hint: A closing time earlier than the opening time runs past midnight; the same time for both means open all day.
settings.ai_enabled: Let the AI answer from the FAQs
settings.ai_missing: No AI provider is enabled (AI settings)
settings.ai_rule_faq: The AI only rewrites one of the published FAQs for the customer. If none answers the ticket it stays silent.
settings.ai_rule_person: Money, payments, fraud, complaints, legal / medical questions and requests for a person are never answered automatically.
settings.ai_rule_label: The customer can answer "That solved it" (closes the ticket) or "I still need a person" (stops the automatic replies and notifies you).

wallets.title: Wallets
wallets.search: Search by name, phone or email…
wallets.reason_required: A written reason is required (at least 3 characters).
wallets.adjust_hint: A correction is a new ledger row attributed to you, with a matching income/expense entry. Choose the balance type on purpose: spend-only money can never be withdrawn.

withdrawals.title: Withdrawal requests

withdrawals.approve_hint: Transfer the money first, then attach the receipt. Approving turns the reserved amount into a real withdrawal.
withdrawals.rejected: Withdrawal rejected and the money released.

pinrec.title: PIN recovery requests

compare_hint.recovery_document: Compare the two photos. Approve only if they show the same document belonging to the same person.
compare_hint.security_freeze: The wallet was permanently frozen after wrong PIN attempts. Compare the ID photo and the selfie — approve only if they clearly show the same person.

pinrec.approve_hint: Approving resets the wallet PIN to 0000 and notifies the user, who should change it from the wallet.
pinrec.approved: Approved. The PIN was reset to 0000.

rules.title: Fees & bonuses
rules.intro: A positive percent is a fee kept from the top-up; a negative percent is a bonus the platform adds (spend-only, never withdrawable). No matching rule means no fee and no bonus.

rules.hint_fee: Fee — taken from the credited amount
rules.confirm_delete: Are you sure you want to delete this rule?
rules.confirm_delete_selected: Are you sure you want to delete the selected rules?

settings.title: Wallet settings
settings.intro: One row per country. A missing setting fails closed: withdrawals, transfers and debt checks are refused instead of guessing a limit.
settings.debt_hint: How much negative balance is allowed before new requests are blocked. 0 means no debt at all.
settings.fee_hint: DORR's optional cut of a transfer. 0% by default. The rate applied is stamped onto each transaction, so changing it here never rewrites past transfers.
settings.fee_payer_sender: The sender — added on top of the amount
settings.fee_payer_recipient: The recipient — deducted from what they receive

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.no_notifications_desc: Wallet activity and other updates will show up here.

otp.no_channel_available: No delivery channel available for this country.

competitions.title: Competitions
competitions.intro: Competitions come from the data provider. Give each a tier: Big updates every minute during a match, Normal every 3 minutes, Minor rarely, Off isn't followed. A match with a team someone follows goes one tier up.
competitions.name: Competition
competitions.empty: Nothing yet — import a sport's competitions.

settings.title: Sports settings
settings.intro: Scores, fixtures and tables come only from the licensed provider, synced on the server inside one daily request budget — the app never calls the provider.
settings.not_configured: API_SPORTS_KEY isn't set in .env — nothing can be synced yet.
settings.hint_tiers: During a match. When the day's budget is short the governor stretches these on its own.
settings.hint_budget: The reserve is for schedules and postponements; live updates never use it.
settings.hint_share: When the budget is short, each sport still gets at least its share.
settings.hint_prizes: Leave empty to keep prizes closed everywhere. Open a country only after its legal review.
settings.hint_odds: Bookmakers' odds on the match page, for information — no betting. Leave empty to show them nowhere.

usage.title: Requests & budget
usage.hint_factor: ×1 = every tier at its own interval. Above 1 the budget is short and intervals are stretched to last the day.

contests.title: Prediction contests
contests.legal: Prizes are paid only in countries opened in Sports settings — after a legal review (in Saudi Arabia, prize competitions need a Ministry of Commerce permit). Predicting is always free.
contests.name: Name
contests.amounts: Prize per country (per winner, or the pool when split)

events.title: Events
events.notify_hint: {count} interested — those who asked for updates get a notification.
events.reject_note: Why is it rejected? (the organizer sees this)

organizers.title: Organizers
organizers.intro: Organizers submit events from the app. Their events are public only after review, and shown as verified only once the organizer is verified here.
organizers.name: Organizer

settings.title: Discover settings
settings.intro: DORR Discover shows public events from trusted sources — the admin and verified organizers — by city, interest and date.
settings.hint_countries: Leave empty for every country. People can still look at other places when they travel.
settings.hint_ai: The AI only turns a question into filters; it never invents events.
settings.hint_auto: Off: every event waits for review.
settings.max_alerts_per_week: At most per person per week
settings.hint_alerts: Matching people's interests; never the same event twice.
settings.hint_rooms: After this, only the group's admins can write in an event's room.

settings.title: Chat settings
settings.intro: Limits that apply to every chat on the platform. Changes take effect immediately.
settings.hint_deleted_message_retention_days: Then they are purged from the server. 0 = purge right away.
settings.hint_calls_disabled_countries: Accounts in these countries can't make or receive calls (internet calls need a licence in some places).
settings.note_ai: Translate messages, voice to text, chat summary and suggested replies. Each only when the person taps it, and it needs an AI provider switched on in the AI settings (voice to text needs OpenAI, Groq or Google).
settings.hint_public_stories_free: How many public stories one person may have running at a time. 0 = nobody can post one.
settings.note_public_stories: Everyone sees public stories on the app's home page. Phone numbers stay hidden until a message request is accepted.
settings.note_moments: Occasions, greeting cards and their effects. Turning them off never affects messaging.
settings.note_calendar: Personal appointments, the today page and their reminders. Turning it off never affects messaging.

themes.title: Chat themes
themes.intro: People pick one of these for each chat (wallpaper + bubble colours). The default is used where nobody picked one.
themes.confirm_delete: Delete the theme "{name}"? Chats using it go back to the default.
